retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, comic-inspired portrait style featuring heavy black hatching, vibrant primary colors, and blocky hand-drawn lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central illustrated figure with exaggerated features, defined by thick black outlines and dense cross-hatching, set against a flat vibrant background with a thick border and blocky, hand-drawn display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject contained within a secondary internal frame
High-contrast black ink textures against flat color fills
Typography integrated into the top and bottom margins
coreInvariants: Dense black hatching for shadows and texture
Thick, irregular black outlines on all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyewear, framed by a dark red border.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large top-left text, down through the subject's face, to the smaller text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large flat yellow margins surrounding the central framed illustration.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with extreme value contrast provided by black ink hatching.

letterConstructionRules: Varying baseline for a playful, urban feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'O' and 'D' have squared-off corners
Horizontal strokes are often thicker than vertical ones
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom-lettering style used in varying scales for hierarchy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a comic-style portrait of a figure with heavy black hatching and vibrant colors, framed by a red border on a flat yellow background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom, blocky, hand-drawn red lettering with thick black outlines and drop shadows in the top and bottom margins.

verificationChecks: Is the hatching dense and black?
Is the background a flat, vibrant yellow?
Does the text have a heavy black drop shadow?
Is the subject contained within a secondary frame?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent hatching style across the image
Ensure text is legible despite the rugged style
Verify the yellow background remains flat and untextured
Confirm the red border is distinct and frames the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Comic Hatching + Block Lettering + Primary Palette + Framed Portrait
